en: Which courses are available on Tech Monster?
What courses can I enroll in?
or: Tech Monster re kana kana course achhi
mu keun course re enroll kariparibi
hi: Tech Monster par kaun kaun se courses available hain
main kaun se course mein enroll kar sakta hoon
mixed: Tech Monster re kaun se courses available achhi
mu kaun se course re enroll kariparibi

answers.en: Tech Monster currently provides the courses available in the Courses section of the platform. Open the Courses section to see the currently available courses and their details.
answers.or: Tech Monster re currently available course guda Courses section re dekhapariba. Courses section open kari available course au details check kara.
answers.hi: Tech Monster par currently available courses Courses section mein milenge. Courses section open karke available courses aur unki details check karein.
answers.mixed: Tech Monster re currently available courses Courses section re dekhapariba. Seithi course au details check kara.

en: How do I enroll in a course?
How can I join a course?
I want to enroll in a course
How can I start a course?
or: mu course re kemiti join karibi
mu course re enroll karibaku chahunchi
hi: main course mein enroll karna chahta hoon
mixed: main course re kemiti join karibi

answers.en: Open the course you want to take and use the enrollment option provided on the course page. After successful enrollment, you can access the course from your dashboard.
answers.or: Jahaku tume karibaku chahucha sehi course open kari course page re thiba enrollment option use kara. Enrollment successful hele dashboard ru course access karipariba.
answers.hi: Jis course ko aap karna chahte hain use open karein aur course page par diya gaya enrollment option use karein. Successful enrollment ke baad course dashboard se access kar sakte hain.
answers.mixed: Jaha course re join karibaku chahucha sehi course open kari enrollment option use kara. Successful hele dashboard ru course access karipariba.

en: Where can I see course details?
How can I see course information?
hi: course ki details kahan dekh sakta hoon

answers.en: Open the relevant course from the Courses section to view its available information, modules and learning content.
answers.or: Courses section ru relevant course open kari sethara available information, modules au learning content dekhapariba.
answers.hi: Courses section se relevant course open karke uski available information, modules aur learning content dekh sakte hain.
answers.mixed: Courses section ru relevant course open kari information, modules au learning content dekhapariba.
